recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, three-layered composition featuring a distressed red background with faint damask patterns, a central ornate gold filigree crest, and bold, black, weathered slab-serif typography that integrates with the illustrative elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Black typography as the primary foreground anchor
Gold filigree acting as a halo/frame for the text
Deep red background providing high-contrast warmth
Distressed textures unifying all three layers
coreInvariants: Weathered/stamped ink texture on all elements
Acanthus leaf or baroque scrollwork motifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is centrally justified, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black capital letters in the upper and lower thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Center-outward; the eye hits the dark text first, then radiates to the gold filigree, then the textured red background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Active negative space created by the red background, which contains subtle tonal variations and faint scrollwork.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Crimson red background with dark red tonal distressing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale gold/tan for the ornate filigree.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red with low-value black and mid-value gold; creates a 'vintage royal' feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab-serif and thick-stroke lowercase serif
letterConstructionRules: Integration of illustrative swashes into letter descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Descender of the primary capital letter in the bottom row transforms into a stylized acanthus leaf or feather motif.

composition.relationshipToImage: Text sits on top of filigree but shares its distressed texture

treatment.texture: Grunge/Stamp effect with red speckles showing through

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between massive uppercase slabs and smaller, rounder lowercase serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and structure.
Matches the geometric slab feel of the capital letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep crimson red background with a distressed, weathered texture and faint, dark red damask patterns. In the center, place a large, ornate gold acanthus leaf filigree crest with a stamped, slightly eroded texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered, black, heavy slab-serif text. The text should be tightly stacked so the lines nearly touch. Apply a grunge/stamped ink texture to the text so the red background occasionally peeks through. Extend the descender of one bottom-row letter into a decorative leaf flourish that matches the gold filigree style.

verificationChecks: Is the red background sufficiently textured and not a flat color?
Does the black text have a weathered, stamped appearance?
Is the gold filigree centered behind the text?
Are the slab serifs thick and blocky?

adjustableVariables: Shade of red (from bright crimson to deep burgundy)
Amount of overlap between text lines
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black text is the darkest element in the composition.
Verify the filigree does not obscure the legibility of the text.
Check that the 'stamped' texture is consistent across all layers.
Confirm the background damask is subtle and low-contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered Grunge Heraldry: [Color A] distressed background + [Color B] ornate filigree + [Color C] heavy slab-serif display type with integrated flourishes.
